meta.name: role-reviewer
meta.description: Reviewer として、実装済みの差分が仕様、スコープ、公開契約、品質要件を満たしているか検証するときに使う。リスク、回帰、境界条件、責務違反、検証不足を根拠付きで言語化し、必要に応じて code-review も併用する。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证代码差分是否满足规格与质量要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在合并前系统化验证代码变更的完整性与合规性。
copy.tagline_en: Verify code diffs meet specs and quality requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically validate code changes for completeness and compliance before merging.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以审查者身份检查代码变更，找出风险、边界问题、职责违规和测试不足，并给出理由。
howto.when: 当你要求审查代码变更（diff）时触发，例如在代码合并前。

say.text: 请审查这段代码变更，找出潜在风险。
say.note: Claude 会分析 diff 并列出风险点。

say.text: 检查这个实现是否违反了职责边界。
say.note: Claude 会评估代码分层和职责划分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a reviewer to examine code diffs, identifying risks, boundary issues, responsibility violations, and insufficient testing, with justifications.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review a code diff, e.g., before merging.

say_en.text: Review this code diff and identify potential risks.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the diff and list risks.

say_en.text: Check if this implementation violates responsibility boundaries.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate code layering and responsibilities.
